name: Iterative Process Flow
purpose: To visualize a cyclical development process that transforms initial specifications into a final model through iterative feedback loops.
use_when: Use when showing a non-linear workflow where inputs are refined through a central iterative cycle to reach a set of outcomes.
avoid_when: Avoid for simple linear timelines or slides requiring heavy data visualization.
notes: The central cycle contains three fixed text areas; the left and right columns are for bulleted lists of inputs and outputs respectively.

imagery.depicts: a circular arrow diagram representing a cycle
